negative_reviews.author: Kelly Sunter
negative_reviews.text: This was my first time attending this restaurant in Metro Centre and it was very disappointing. For my daughter's birthday we decided to go here, she is obsessed with ramen noodles. Tried dishes she's had before in the UK and USA and it was very underwhelming or terrible as she describes it. It did not look nice. The broth and noodles were very hot while the egg, meat, and vegetables were cold. The ramen bowl was half filled. The broth was meant to be darker and it was pale, not dark enough for black garlic. My main meal dish didn't arrive and I had to chase the server as noone noticed. My daughter begged I did not tell them how awful her meal was.  The server on checking apologised and said i did not have to pay for my daughters meal owing to my meal not arriving and my daughter had finished her ramen bu then. The situation spolit our dining experience, we wanted to eat together.  We would never go back again and had to go elsewhere for lunch. Environment looked nice and chop sticks good quality.  It was too loud where we were sitting from the music to hear each other speak. Also the light did not have a shade on and situated middle of the table and far too bright. It triggered a headache. Awful dining experience. The server explained they dont know what happened to my order whether it got lost or simply the chef forgot. Worrisome considering it was not busy on arrival. I was really looking forward to trying here I would never recommend it to anyone.

negative_reviews.text: Went in with family for the first time . Very poor service . They took more than 40 mins just for the dessert . Food was average .

negative_reviews.author: Harrison Mudge
negative_reviews.text:
Went for the first time today. Had the tonkatsu ramen and salmon sushi.
Sushi was nice. It had a lightly fried batter outer which gave it a nice crisp crunch and the cooked salmon centre was nice too. Sadly the wasabi on the side that it came with was more sweet than hot. Personally I like my wasabi hot.
Then the ramen as my main, all I can really say is it was exceedingly mid. The broth. Was nice, not particularly salty or strong but it was nice. The noodles didn’t really absorb much of the flavour though and the pork while flavourful was a bit tough.
To answer the question of would I have if all again, then the answer would be no sadly.
I also personally hate when they automatically add a service charge to the bill, forcing you to have to ask to have it removed.

negative_reviews.text: The restaraunt was quite slow service and forgot a lot of our items and we had to ask multiple times for them. But to be fair to them they did give us 25% off our bill. Probably wouldn’t recommend. Thanks

negative_reviews.author: Maria Salamanca
negative_reviews.text: Had super high expectations given the good reviews but the service was really bad… servers were unfriendly, mains came out at very different times so one of us was done eating by the time the other’s main came and there were lots of dirty tables around us. The food was ok but the ramen was served a bit cold.

negative_reviews.author: Maya “mayaearth” Earth
negative_reviews.text:
I went for dinner there today, food was delicious but the service was quiet bad.
I've ordered 2 ramen and 2 side dishes, I've made sure to mention that we would start with the side dishes and then the ramen, specifying to the manager who was taking orders on her pad, the extra beef topping that would go for both. Few minutes later they serve us one ramen. We ask if the second one is coming they say yes. Then the manager comes 5 minutes later, saying we ordered only one ramen, wish I anwser that we ordered two, she ask if we could have this one for now, as it will go soggy. I tell her that I won't be eating the ramen by myself while my partner is watching. She just storms off without a word. When the bill came we noticed that she charged us for three ramen, the other waitress took care of rectifying the bill, we saw that manager coming to her with a smirk to ask what was going on. At the end it got sorted, but we felt that this lady managing, and taking order, needs way more training in customer service, and stop trying to sneakly scam people by adding more to the bill to cover for her own mistake. None of less food was delicious  especially the teriyaki chiken, I would've recommended this restaurant, if it wasn't for this women.

negative_reviews.author: Sponge
negative_reviews.text:
Service was diabolical, which i dont think was a fault of the junior staff but from poor management. I did note a few individuals who I sussed were management having a bit of an attitude towards their junior staff members.  The food came out in staggered stages. People who had arrived some time after us received the whole of their order before ours was complete.  The ramen was brought out first, luke warm. Ages later the remainder of our order followed. Our stomachs are playing up today and I believe this to be a fault of food temperatures. Was the kicthen understaffed, who knows. I have been to many ramen restaurants and unfortunately this wasnt great.
The toilets were disgusting, clearly not checked throughout the day.

Overall, a poor experience,  which is a shame really.

****

****

negative_reviews.author: Ali ALSaeedi
negative_reviews.text:
The food was below average and the overall experience was disappointing. The restaurant wasn’t busy and there were plenty of empty tables, but because it was just me and my daughter, they seated us right next to the bar where staff were constantly bringing drinks to customers. The space was very small and uncomfortable.

When I asked if we could move to another table, they told us all the other tables were booked. However, it was quite clear that this wasn’t the case, as there were plenty of empty tables. In fact, the restaurant was even quieter when we left than when we arrived.

Very disappointing experience, and unfortunately, not somewhere I would rush back to.
